Ukraine front line, night of 28 July 2026:

Ukraine's air defence downed 107 of 131 drones launched by Russian forces overnight into 28 July; impacts recorded at nine locations.

Over the past day, 227 combat clashes took place between Ukraine's Defence Forces and Russian troops, with the Pokrovsk and Kostiantynivka directions the most intense.
